name: How do I choose the right contractor for log cabin refinishing?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for log cabin refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor with genuine finish carpentry and structural repair experience, not just standard house painters. Log homes require specific knowledge of wood movement, specialized breathable finishes, and moisture management. You also benefit from choosing an owner-operated service where the principal contractor leads the project directly on-site rather than subcontracting out critical prep work. An experienced contractor will conduct a thorough adhesion test, inspect corner notches and log ends for hidden decay, and offer clear solutions for both wood preservation and exterior chinking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor experienced in log carpentry, rot repair, and specialized timber coatings who provides hands-on job oversight rather than treating the job like ordinary house painting.
